exportErrorLogsModal.title: Export Error Logs
exportErrorLogsModal.instructions: Follow these steps to send error logs to our support team:
exportErrorLogsModal.step1Desc: Select a location (like Desktop) to save the error logs file
exportErrorLogsModal.step2Desc: Your default email client will open with a pre-filled message
exportErrorLogsModal.step3Desc: Attach the error logs file you just saved to the email
exportErrorLogsModal.step4Desc: Add details about the problem you're experiencing and send the email
exportErrorLogsModal.note: Note: The logs file contains system information to help us diagnose issues. No personal data is included.
